WITH mapping AS (
  SELECT 
    u.phone,
    c.name AS complex_name
  FROM `analytics-454817.postgresql.users` AS u
  JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresql.space_user` AS su 
    ON u.id = su.user_id
  JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresql.spaces` AS s 
    ON su.space_id = s.id
  JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresql.sections` AS sec 
    ON s.section_id = sec.id
  JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresql.houses` AS h 
    ON sec.house_id = h.id
  JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresql.complexes` AS c 
    ON h.complex_id = c.id
)
SELECT
  e.amplitude_id,
  event_type,
  JSON_VALUE(e.user_properties, "$.phone_number") as phone_number,
  JSON_VALUE(e.user_properties, "$.object_selected") as object_selected,
  m.complex_name
FROM `analytics-454817.amlitude_EU.EVENTS_407641` AS e
LEFT JOIN mapping m
  ON JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(e.user_properties, '$.phone_number') = m.phone;

WITH section_agg AS (
    SELECT
        house_id,
        COUNT(*)                                    AS section_count,
        MIN(base_floor)                             AS min_floor,
        MAX(base_floor + COALESCE(floors, 1) - 1)  AS max_floor,
        STRING_AGG(
            CASE WHEN name NOT IN ('-', '') THEN name ELSE NULL END,
            ', ' ORDER BY name
        )                                           AS named_sections
    FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.sections`
    GROUP BY house_id
)
SELECT
    h.id                            AS building_id,
    h.number                        AS building_number,
    h.complex_id,
    c.name                          AS complex_name,
    COALESCE(h.status, 'active')    AS building_status,
    h.use_complex_payment_provider,
    s.section_count,
    s.min_floor,
    s.max_floor,
    s.named_sections,
    h.location_id,
    h.created_at                    AS building_created_at
FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.houses` h
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.complexes` c ON c.id = h.complex_id
LEFT JOIN section_agg s ON s.house_id = h.id

SELECT
    id                      AS user_id,
    last_name,
    first_name,
    patronymic,
    CONCAT(
        last_name, ' ', first_name,
        CASE WHEN patronymic IS NOT NULL AND patronymic != ''
             THEN CONCAT(' ', patronymic) ELSE '' END
    )                       AS full_name,
    phone,
    verified                AS is_verified,
    role                    AS user_role,
    created_at              AS registered_at
FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.users`

SELECT
    iban,
    recipient_name                                  AS llc_name,
    merchant_id,
    CAST(mfo AS STRING)                             AS bank_mfo,
    commission_profile_id,
    REPLACE(REPLACE(recipient_name, '""', '"'), '"', '') AS llc_name_clean
FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.tascombank_merchants`
WHERE purpose = 'payment'

SELECT
    id                  AS complex_id,
    name                AS complex_name,
    payment_provider    AS complex_payment_provider,
    CASE
        WHEN STARTS_WITH(name, 'БЦ') THEN 'business_centre'
        WHEN STARTS_WITH(name, 'ЖК') THEN 'residential_complex'
        ELSE 'other'
    END                 AS complex_type,
    created_at          AS complex_created_at
FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.complexes`

SELECT
    CAST(service_id AS INT64)       AS service_type_code,
    ARRAY_AGG(name ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS service_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id)              AS account_service_count
FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.master_buh_service`
GROUP BY 1

SELECT
    -- ── ОРИГІНАЛЬНІ КЛЮЧІ ТА ГЕО-ЛАНЦЮЖОК ──────────────────────────────
    sp.id AS space_id,
    sp.section_id,
    sec.house_id,
    sec.name AS section_name,
    h.number AS building_number,
    h.complex_id,
    c.name AS complex_name,
    CASE
        WHEN STARTS_WITH(c.name, 'БЦ') THEN 'business_centre'
        WHEN STARTS_WITH(c.name, 'ЖК') THEN 'residential_complex'
        ELSE 'other'
    END AS complex_type,

    -- ── АТРИБУТИ ПРИМІЩЕННЯ ───────────────────────────────────────────
    sp.number AS space_number,
    sp.floor,
    sp.kind AS property_kind,
    
    -- ★ ОНОВЛЕНА ЛОГИКА (Дивимось у підтипи комерції)
    CASE 
        WHEN sp.kind = 'apartment' THEN 'Квартира'
        WHEN sp.kind = 'commercial' AND sc.type = 'parking' THEN 'Паркінг'
        WHEN sp.kind = 'commercial' AND sc.type = 'storeroom' THEN 'Комора'
        WHEN sp.kind = 'commercial' THEN 'Комерційне'
        ELSE sp.kind
    END AS property_kind_ua,

    -- ── ВЛАСНИК ТА БОРГ ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    sp.owner_id,
    sp.cached_debt,

    -- ── ДЕТАЛІЗАЦІЯ (Квартири та Комерція) ────────────────────────────
    sa.account AS apartment_account_code, 
    sa.account AS personal_account,       
    sc.type AS commercial_type,
    sc.dabi AS commercial_dabi_code,      
    
    -- ── АУДИТ ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    sp.updated_at AS space_updated_at     
FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.spaces` sp
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.sections` sec ON sec.id = sp.section_id
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.houses` h ON h.id = sec.house_id
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.complexes` c ON c.id = h.complex_id
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.space_apartments` sa ON sa.id = sp.id
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.space_commercials` sc ON sc.id = sp.id

SELECT
    msp.id                                          AS billing_id,
    SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', msp.period)             AS billing_month, -- Исправлено здесь
    msp.service_id                                  AS service_uuid,
    CAST(mbs.service_id AS INT64)                   AS service_type_code,
    mbi.space_id,
    msp.iban,
    msp.okpo,
    CAST(msp.amount_of_charges AS NUMERIC)          AS amount_of_charges,
    CAST(msp.paid_amount       AS NUMERIC)          AS paid_amount,
    CAST(msp.initial_debt      AS NUMERIC)          AS initial_debt,
    CAST(msp.price_to_pay      AS NUMERIC)          AS price_to_pay,
    GREATEST(
        CAST(msp.amount_of_charges AS NUMERIC)
        - CAST(msp.paid_amount     AS NUMERIC),
        0
    )                                               AS unpaid_charges,
    msp.is_paid,
    msp.is_preview,
    msp.synced_at,
    msp.created_at                                  AS record_created_at
FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.master_buh_service_payment` msp
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.master_buh_service` mbs ON mbs.id = msp.service_id
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.master_buh_information` mbi ON mbi.id = mbs.master_buh_information_id

SELECT
    msp.id                                          AS billing_id,
    SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', msp.period)             AS snapshot_month, -- Исправлено здесь
    LAST_DAY(SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', msp.period))   AS snapshot_month_end, -- Исправлено здесь
    msp.service_id                                  AS service_uuid,
    CAST(mbs.service_id AS INT64)                   AS service_type_code,
    mbi.space_id,
    msp.iban,
    msp.okpo,
    CAST(msp.initial_debt      AS NUMERIC)          AS debt_balance,
    CAST(msp.amount_of_charges AS NUMERIC)          AS current_month_charges,
    CAST(msp.paid_amount       AS NUMERIC)          AS paid_amount,
    GREATEST(
        CAST(msp.initial_debt      AS NUMERIC)
        - CAST(msp.amount_of_charges AS NUMERIC),
        0
    )                                               AS prior_debt_carryover,
    CAST(msp.initial_debt AS NUMERIC) > 0           AS is_debtor,
    CASE
        WHEN CAST(msp.initial_debt AS NUMERIC) <= 0    THEN 'no_debt'
        WHEN CAST(msp.initial_debt AS NUMERIC) <= 1000 THEN '≤1000'
        ELSE '>1000'
    END                                             AS debt_bucket,
    msp.is_preview,
    msp.synced_at
FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.master_buh_service_payment` msp
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.master_buh_service` mbs ON mbs.id = msp.service_id
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.master_buh_information` mbi ON mbi.id = mbs.master_buh_information_id
WHERE CAST(msp.amount_of_charges AS NUMERIC) > 0 OR CAST(msp.initial_debt AS NUMERIC) > 0

SELECT
    op.id                                           AS operation_id,
    op.transaction_id,
    op.service_payment_id                           AS billing_id,
    DATE(op.created_at, 'Europe/Kiev')              AS payment_date,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(op.created_at, 'Europe/Kiev'), MONTH) AS payment_month,
    tx.payer_id,
    op.amount / 100.0                               AS payment_amount,
    CAST(op.commission AS NUMERIC)                  AS commission_amount,
    tx.payment_provider,
    tx.type                                         AS transaction_type,
    tx.payment_id                                   AS bank_payment_reference,
    op.status                                       AS operation_status,
    tx.status                                       AS transaction_status
FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.operations` op
JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.transactions` tx ON tx.id = op.transaction_id
WHERE op.status = 'accepted' AND tx.status = 'accepted' AND op.paid_order_id IS NULL

SELECT
    f.billing_id,
    f.billing_month,
    f.amount_of_charges,
    f.paid_amount,
    f.unpaid_charges,
    f.initial_debt,
    f.price_to_pay,
    f.is_paid,
    f.synced_at,
    f.record_created_at,
    f.space_id,
    
    -- Географія та атрибути
    COALESCE(s.complex_name,     'Невідомий ЖК')       AS complex_name,
    COALESCE(s.building_number,  'Невідомий будинок')  AS building_number,
    s.section_name,
    s.space_number,
    
    -- ★ ТУТ ВІДБУВАЄТЬСЯ МАГІЯ РОЗДІЛЕННЯ (тягнемо нову логіку з dim_space)
    COALESCE(s.property_kind_ua, 'Тип не вказано')     AS property_kind_ua,
    s.property_kind,
    s.complex_type,
    
    -- Особові рахунки (додали personal_account для синхронізації з боргами)
    s.personal_account,       
    s.apartment_account_code, 
    
    -- Фінанси та послуги
    f.iban,
    COALESCE(l.llc_name_clean,   'Невідоме ТОВ')       AS llc_name,
    f.okpo,
    f.service_type_code,
    COALESCE(sv.service_name,    'Невідома послуга')   AS service_name

FROM `analytics-454817.finance_dash.fact_billing` f
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_space` s  ON s.space_id = f.space_id
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_llc` l  ON l.iban = f.iban
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_service` sv ON sv.service_type_code = f.service_type_code
WHERE f.is_preview = FALSE

WITH current_debts AS (
    SELECT
        snapshot_month,
        space_id,
        service_type_code,
        MAX(complex_name)     AS complex_name,
        MAX(llc_name)         AS llc_name,
        MAX(iban)             AS iban,
        MAX(building_number)  AS building_number,
        MAX(property_kind_ua) AS property_kind_ua,
        MAX(service_name)     AS service_name,
        -- >>> ЗМІНА 1: борг за методикою Аліони (мінус оплати)
        SUM(debt_balance) - SUM(paid_amount) AS total_debt
    FROM `analytics-454817.finance_dash.mart_debt_flat`
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
    -- >>> ЗМІНА 2: лишаємо лише позитивний нетто-борг
    HAVING SUM(debt_balance) - SUM(paid_amount) > 0
),
historical_charges AS (
    SELECT
        space_id,
        service_type_code,
        billing_month,
        SUM(amount_of_charges) AS monthly_billed
    FROM `analytics-454817.finance_dash.mart_billing_flat`
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
    HAVING monthly_billed > 0
),
allocated_debts AS (
    SELECT
        c.snapshot_month,
        c.space_id,
        c.complex_name,
        c.llc_name,
        c.iban,
        c.building_number,
        c.property_kind_ua,
        c.service_name,
        c.total_debt,
        h.billing_month,
        COALESCE(h.monthly_billed, 0) AS monthly_billed,
        SUM(COALESCE(h.monthly_billed, 0)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.snapshot_month, c.space_id, c.service_type_code
            ORDER BY h.billing_month DESC
        ) AS running_total_charges,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.snapshot_month, c.space_id, c.service_type_code
            ORDER BY h.billing_month ASC
        ) AS is_oldest_row
    FROM current_debts c
    LEFT JOIN historical_charges h
           ON c.space_id = h.space_id
          AND c.service_type_code = h.service_type_code
          -- >>> ЗМІНА 3: СТРОГО менше — поточний місяць не бере участі в розподілі
          AND h.billing_month < c.snapshot_month
),
aged_chunks AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN billing_month IS NULL THEN total_debt
            WHEN is_oldest_row = 1 AND total_debt > running_total_charges
                THEN monthly_billed + (total_debt - running_total_charges)
            WHEN running_total_charges <= total_debt THEN monthly_billed
            WHEN (running_total_charges - monthly_billed) < total_debt
                THEN total_debt - (running_total_charges - monthly_billed)
            ELSE 0
        END AS allocated_debt
    FROM allocated_debts
),
aged_with_buckets AS (
    SELECT
        snapshot_month,
        space_id,
        complex_name,
        llc_name,
        iban,
        building_number,
        property_kind_ua,
        service_name,
        allocated_debt,
        -- >>> ЗМІНА 4: вік рахуємо в МІСЯЦЯХ (а не днях). Інакше «сусідній місяць»
        --     = 91 день і перестрибує корзину 61-90, лишаючи її порожньою.
        COALESCE(DATE_DIFF(snapshot_month, billing_month, MONTH), 999) AS months_old
    FROM aged_chunks
    WHERE allocated_debt > 0
)
SELECT
    snapshot_month,
    complex_name,
    llc_name,
    iban,
    building_number,
    property_kind_ua,
    service_name,
    -- Корзина 0-30 (поточний місяць) відсутня за побудовою (billing_month < snapshot_month)
    CASE
        WHEN months_old <= 1 THEN '2. 31–60 днів'
        WHEN months_old = 2  THEN '3. 61–90 днів'
        WHEN months_old <= 6 THEN '4. 91–180 днів'
        ELSE '5. 180+ днів'
    END AS aging_bucket,
    CASE
        WHEN months_old <= 1 THEN 2
        WHEN months_old = 2  THEN 3
        WHEN months_old <= 6 THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END AS aging_sort_order,
    COUNT(DISTINCT space_id)  AS accounts_in_bucket,
    SUM(allocated_debt)       AS debt_in_bucket
FROM aged_with_buckets
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9

WITH per_space AS (
    SELECT
        fd.space_id,
        fd.snapshot_month,
        SUM(fd.debt_balance)  AS saldo_poch,
        SUM(fd.paid_amount)   AS paid,
        SUM(fd.debt_balance) - SUM(fd.paid_amount) AS overdue_debt,
        SUM(fd.current_month_charges) AS current_month_charges,   -- ★ НОВЕ: нарахування за місяць
        MAX(fd.iban)          AS iban
    FROM `analytics-454817.finance_dash.fact_debt` fd
    WHERE fd.is_preview = FALSE
    GROUP BY fd.space_id, fd.snapshot_month
)
SELECT
    ps.space_id,
    ps.snapshot_month,
    ps.saldo_poch,
    ps.paid,
    ps.overdue_debt,

    -- Прапорці
    CASE WHEN ps.overdue_debt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_debtor,
    CASE WHEN ps.overdue_debt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_overpaid,

    -- debt_bucket на основі НОВОЇ формули (overdue_debt, а не старого initial_debt)
    CASE
        WHEN ps.overdue_debt <= 0    THEN 'no_debt'
        WHEN ps.overdue_debt <= 1000 THEN '≤1000'
        ELSE '>1000'
    END AS debt_bucket,

    -- Атрибути для фільтрів і розрізів
    s.complex_name,
    s.complex_type,
    s.building_number,
    s.property_kind_ua,
    s.personal_account,
    s.space_number,
    COALESCE(l.llc_name_clean, 'Невідоме ТОВ') AS llc_name,

    -- ★ НОВЕ ПОЛЕ (в кінці, щоб не зсувати наявні): нарахування за місяць
    ps.current_month_charges
FROM per_space ps
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_space` s ON s.space_id = ps.space_id
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_llc` l ON l.iban = ps.iban

SELECT
    fd.billing_id,
    fd.snapshot_month,
    fd.snapshot_month_end,
    fd.debt_balance,
    fd.paid_amount,
    fd.prior_debt_carryover,
    fd.is_debtor,
    fd.debt_bucket,
    fd.space_id,
    fd.okpo,
    fd.service_type_code,
    fd.synced_at,
    s.personal_account,
    s.space_number,
    s.property_kind,
    s.property_kind_ua,
    s.complex_name,
    s.building_number,
    s.complex_type,
    fd.prior_debt_carryover  AS overdue_debt_on_1st,
    fd.current_month_charges AS current_month_charges,
    fd.debt_balance          AS total_debt,
 
    -- ★ НОВЕ ПОЛЕ: дебіторка за методикою Аліони (СальдоКін − Нараховано)
    (fd.debt_balance - fd.current_month_charges) AS overdue_debt_alena,
 
    -- ★ НОВЕ ПОЛЕ (для задачі 4): питома вага боргу від нарахувань
    -- рахується в Looker через SUM, тут просто сирі компоненти
    -- (див. calculated field нижче)
 
    COALESCE(l.llc_name_clean, 'Невідоме ТОВ') AS llc_name,
    COALESCE(sv.service_name, 'Невідома послуга') AS service_name,
    fd.iban
FROM `analytics-454817.finance_dash.fact_debt` fd
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_space` s ON s.space_id = fd.space_id
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_llc` l ON l.iban = fd.iban
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_service` sv ON sv.service_type_code = fd.service_type_code
WHERE fd.is_preview = FALSE
  AND fd.debt_balance >= 0.01

WITH current_debts AS (
    SELECT
        space_id,
        service_type_code,
        MAX(complex_name)    AS complex_name,
        MAX(llc_name)        AS llc_name,
        MAX(building_number) AS building_number,
        SUM(debt_balance)    AS total_debt
    FROM `analytics-454817.finance_dash.mart_debt_flat`
    WHERE snapshot_month = (
        SELECT MAX(snapshot_month)
        FROM `analytics-454817.finance_dash.mart_debt_flat`
    )
    GROUP BY 1, 2
    HAVING SUM(debt_balance) > 0
),
historical_charges AS (
    SELECT
        space_id,
        service_type_code,
        billing_month,
        SUM(amount_of_charges) AS monthly_billed
    FROM `analytics-454817.finance_dash.mart_billing_flat`
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
    HAVING monthly_billed > 0
),
allocated_debts AS (
    SELECT
        c.space_id,
        c.complex_name,
        c.llc_name,
        c.building_number,
        c.total_debt,
        h.billing_month,
        COALESCE(h.monthly_billed, 0) AS monthly_billed,
        SUM(COALESCE(h.monthly_billed, 0)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.space_id, c.service_type_code
            ORDER BY h.billing_month DESC
        ) AS running_total_charges,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.space_id, c.service_type_code
            ORDER BY h.billing_month ASC
        ) AS is_oldest_row,
        -- Вік боргу в днях від кінця останнього snapshot_month
        COALESCE(
            DATE_DIFF(
                LAST_DAY((SELECT MAX(snapshot_month) FROM `analytics-454817.finance_dash.mart_debt_flat`)),
                billing_month,
                DAY
            ),
            999
        ) AS age_days
    FROM current_debts c
    LEFT JOIN historical_charges h
           ON c.space_id = h.space_id
          AND c.service_type_code = h.service_type_code
),
aged_chunks AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN billing_month IS NULL THEN total_debt
            WHEN is_oldest_row = 1 AND total_debt > running_total_charges
                THEN monthly_billed + (total_debt - running_total_charges)
            WHEN running_total_charges <= total_debt THEN monthly_billed
            WHEN (running_total_charges - monthly_billed) < total_debt
                THEN total_debt - (running_total_charges - monthly_billed)
            ELSE 0
        END AS allocated_debt
    FROM allocated_debts
)
SELECT
    complex_name,
    llc_name,
    building_number,
    COALESCE(
        CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM billing_month) AS STRING),
        'Без історії'
    ) AS debt_year,
    SUM(allocated_debt) AS debt_amount
FROM aged_chunks
WHERE allocated_debt > 0
  AND age_days > 30   -- ← виключаємо 0-30 днів (поточний місяць)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4

WITH space_flag AS (
    SELECT
        f.space_id,
        f.billing_month,
        -- >>> ЗМІНА 1: борг = вхідний борг - оплати (БЕЗ поточних нарахувань,
        --     бо нарахування цього місяця ще не є простроченим боргом)
        CASE WHEN SUM(f.initial_debt) - SUM(f.paid_amount) <= 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_natural
    FROM `analytics-454817.finance_dash.fact_billing` f
    WHERE f.is_preview = FALSE
        AND f.billing_month IS NOT NULL
        AND f.space_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY f.space_id, f.billing_month
    -- >>> ЗМІНА 2: лишаємо лише квартири з нарахуваннями (прибираємо без договору)
    HAVING SUM(f.amount_of_charges) > 0
)

-- 2. Детальний рівень: рядок = (квартира, місяць, послуга), з прапорцем квартири
SELECT
    f.space_id,
    f.billing_month,
    s.complex_name,
    s.complex_type,
    s.property_kind_ua,
    s.building_number,
    COALESCE(l.llc_name_clean, 'Невідоме ТОВ')   AS llc_name,
    COALESCE(sv.service_name, 'Невідома послуга') AS service_name,

    -- Гроші — деталізовані по послузі (можна фільтрувати, дробляться коректно)
    f.amount_of_charges AS charges,
    f.paid_amount       AS payments,

    -- Прапорець природності квартири (однаковий для всіх рядків цієї квартири)
    sf.is_natural,

    -- Оплати від природних — для чистого рівня
    CASE WHEN sf.is_natural = 1
         THEN f.paid_amount ELSE 0
    END AS payment_if_natural,

    -- Поле залишено для зворотної сумісності дешборду (стара метрика природного).
    -- Рекомендовано перевести природній на формулу Артема (блок МЕТРИКИ нижче),
    -- після чого це поле можна прибрати.
    CASE WHEN f.paid_amount >= f.amount_of_charges
         THEN f.amount_of_charges
         ELSE f.paid_amount
    END AS payment_for_current

FROM `analytics-454817.finance_dash.fact_billing` f
-- >>> ЗМІНА 3: INNER (а не LEFT) — відсікає квартири з нульовими нарахуваннями
INNER JOIN space_flag sf
    ON sf.space_id = f.space_id AND sf.billing_month = f.billing_month
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_space` s
    ON s.space_id = f.space_id
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_llc` l
    ON l.iban = f.iban
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_service` sv
    ON sv.service_type_code = f.service_type_code
WHERE f.is_preview = FALSE
    AND f.billing_month IS NOT NULL
    AND f.space_id IS NOT NULL

WITH space_month AS (
    -- Нарахування/оплати/вхідний борг на рівні (квартира, місяць), по всіх послугах
    SELECT
        space_id,
        billing_month,
        SUM(amount_of_charges) AS charges,
        SUM(paid_amount)       AS paid,
        SUM(initial_debt)      AS opening_debt
    FROM `analytics-454817.finance_dash.fact_billing`
    WHERE is_preview = FALSE AND space_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
    HAVING SUM(amount_of_charges) <> 0   -- прибираємо квартири без договору
),
flag AS (
    -- Прапорець "дисциплінований" на місяць n: чи погашено вхідний борг оплатами цього місяця
    SELECT
        space_id,
        billing_month,
        paid,
        CASE WHEN (opening_debt - paid) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_natural
    FROM space_month
)
SELECT
    c.space_id,
    -- Перейменовано з charge_month -> billing_month для сумісності зі старими
    -- вітринами/фільтрами (mart_payment_rates, mart_billing_flat теж звуть це
    -- поле billing_month). Це "місяць, за який нараховано" — саме його треба
    -- ставити як Date Range Dimension в Looker, щоб обраний місяць у фільтрі
    -- відповідав місяцю нарахування, а не місяцю надходження оплат.
    c.billing_month                        AS billing_month,
    DATE_ADD(c.billing_month, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS payment_month, -- місяць, коли ці оплати надійшли
    s.complex_name,
    s.complex_type,
    s.property_kind_ua,
    s.building_number,

    c.charges                              AS charges,            -- нарахування місяця X
    n.paid                                  AS payments,           -- оплати місяця X+1 (когортні)
    n.is_natural,                                                  -- дисципліна за станом на X+1
    CASE WHEN n.is_natural = 1 THEN n.paid ELSE 0 END AS payment_if_natural,

    -- ★ Погашення боргу минулих періодів (за пропозицією Артема): скільки з оплат
    --   ЦЬОГО (X) місяця пішло понад поточне нарахування X, тобто на старий борг.
    --   Рахується на рівні квартири і floor(...,0) — щоб переплата однієї квартири
    --   не "компенсувала" недоплату іншої при агрегації (сказано на дзвінку).
    GREATEST(c.paid - c.charges, 0)        AS repaid_old_debt_this_month

FROM space_month c
-- >>> ЗМІНА: LEFT (а не INNER) JOIN на "X+1". repaid_old_debt_this_month рахується
--     з ЦЬОГО Ж місяця (c.paid − c.charges), тому не потребує даних наступного
--     місяця і має бути доступний одразу. Рівні оплат (payments/is_natural/
--     payment_if_natural) і далі будуть NULL для найостаннішого місяця, поки
--     не прийдуть дані X+1 — це коректно, не ламати нічого.
LEFT JOIN flag n
    ON n.space_id = c.space_id
   AND n.billing_month = DATE_ADD(c.billing_month, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_space` s ON s.space_id = c.space_id

SELECT
    fp.operation_id,
    fp.transaction_id,
    fp.billing_id,
    fp.payment_date,
    fp.payment_month,
    fb.billing_month,
    fp.payment_amount,
    fp.commission_amount,
    fp.payment_provider,
    fp.transaction_type,
    fp.bank_payment_reference,
    COALESCE(s.complex_name, 'Невідомий ЖК') AS complex_name,
    COALESCE(s.building_number, 'Невідомий будинок') AS building_number,
    
    -- Поділ на Фіз. осіб, Юр. осіб та Паркінги
    CASE 
        WHEN s.property_kind = 'apartment' THEN 'Квартира'
        WHEN s.property_kind = 'commercial' THEN 'Комерція'
        WHEN s.property_kind = 'parking' THEN 'Паркінг'
        ELSE 'Тип не вказано'
    END AS property_kind_ua,
    
    s.complex_type,
    fb.iban,
    COALESCE(l.llc_name_clean, 'Невідоме ТОВ') AS llc_name,
    fb.service_type_code,
    COALESCE(sv.service_name, 'Невідома послуга') AS service_name,
    fb.amount_of_charges
FROM `analytics-454817.finance_dash.fact_payments` fp
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.fact_billing` fb ON fb.billing_id = fp.billing_id
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_space` s ON s.space_id = fb.space_id
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_llc` l ON l.iban = fb.iban
LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_service` sv ON sv.service_type_code = fb.service_type_code
WHERE fb.is_preview = FALSE

WITH billing_totals AS (
    -- Нарахування по місяцях
    SELECT 
        billing_month,
        complex_name,
        COALESCE(MAX(complex_type), 'other') AS complex_type,
        SUM(amount_of_charges) AS total_billed
    FROM `analytics-454817.finance_dash.mart_billing_flat`
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
payments_totals AS (
    -- Усі оплати, що надійшли у конкретному місяці
    SELECT 
        fp.payment_month,
        s.complex_name,
        SUM(fp.payment_amount) AS total_received
    FROM `analytics-454817.finance_dash.fact_payments` fp
    JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.fact_billing` fb 
        ON fb.billing_id = fp.billing_id 
        AND fb.is_preview = FALSE
    JOIN `analytics-454817.finance_dash.dim_space` s 
        ON s.space_id = fb.space_id
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
base_grid AS (
    -- Створюємо єдиний календарний каркас, щоб не загубити дані, 
    -- якщо в якомусь місяці були тільки нарахування або тільки оплати
    SELECT DISTINCT billing_month AS report_month, complex_name FROM billing_totals
    UNION DISTINCT
    SELECT DISTINCT payment_month AS report_month, complex_name FROM payments_totals
)

SELECT 
    g.report_month,
    g.complex_name,
    COALESCE(curr_b.complex_type, prev_b.complex_type, 'other') AS complex_type,
    
    -- Нарахування ПОТОЧНОГО місяця (залишив на випадок, якщо це потрібно для інших графіків)
    COALESCE(curr_b.total_billed, 0) AS total_billed_current,
    
    -- Нарахування ПОПЕРЕДНЬОГО місяця (знаменник для формули)
    COALESCE(prev_b.total_billed, 0) AS total_billed_previous,
    
    -- Оплати ПОТОЧНОГО місяця (чисельник для формули)
    COALESCE(p.total_received, 0) AS total_payments_received,
    
    -- НОВА ЛОГІКА: Оплати поточного / Нарахування попереднього (без множення на 100)
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
        COALESCE(p.total_received, 0), 
        NULLIF(prev_b.total_billed, 0)
    ) AS natural_payment_rate
    
FROM base_grid g
-- Підтягуємо оплати поточного місяця
LEFT JOIN payments_totals p 
    ON p.payment_month = g.report_month 
    AND p.complex_name = g.complex_name
-- Підтягуємо нарахування поточного місяця
LEFT JOIN billing_totals curr_b 
    ON curr_b.billing_month = g.report_month 
    AND curr_b.complex_name = g.complex_name
-- ГОЛОВНИЙ ТРЮК: Підтягуємо нарахування ПОПЕРЕДНЬОГО місяця (зміщуємо дату на 1 місяць вперед)
LEFT JOIN billing_totals prev_b 
    ON DATE_ADD(prev_b.billing_month, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) = g.report_month 
    AND prev_b.complex_name = g.complex_name

WITH user_phones AS (
  SELECT 
    id AS user_id, 
    phone as phone_number
  FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.users`
  WHERE phone IS NOT NULL AND phone != ''
),

user_spaces AS (
  SELECT 
    space_id, 
    user_id
  FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.space_user`
),

spaces_with_sections AS (
  SELECT 
    s.id AS space_id, 
    s.section_id,
    us.user_id
  FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.spaces` s
  JOIN user_spaces us
    ON s.id = us.space_id
),

sections_with_houses AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.section_id, 
    ss.user_id,
    se.house_id
  FROM spaces_with_sections ss
  JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.sections` se
    ON ss.section_id = se.id
),

houses_with_complexes AS (
  SELECT 
    sh.user_id,
    h.complex_id
  FROM sections_with_houses sh
  JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.houses` h
    ON sh.house_id = h.id
)

SELECT 
  u.phone_number, 
  c.name AS complex_name
FROM houses_with_complexes hc
JOIN user_phones u
  ON hc.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.complexes` c
  ON hc.complex_id = c.id

WITH 
-- 1. Справочники отключений ЖК
house_deactivation_dates AS (
  SELECT house_id, DATE(deactivated_date) AS deactivated_date 
  FROM UNNEST([
    STRUCT('e898c6d1-227c-462f-aec2-d4f8949f7f6b' AS house_id, '2025-08-01' AS deactivated_date),
    STRUCT('a72558c9-5f78-4633-a425-b42a79ee3649' AS house_id, '2025-08-01' AS deactivated_date),
    STRUCT('6017b015-6916-41db-9404-dd5b0885434b' AS house_id, '2025-08-01' AS deactivated_date),
    STRUCT('56d86356-cfe1-4382-b3be-d0fe2c0dba3f' AS house_id, '2025-09-01' AS deactivated_date),
    STRUCT('18c381e0-afa9-4b7f-82cd-9d005dca90e1' AS house_id, '2025-09-01' AS deactivated_date),
    STRUCT('ef446c3b-c38f-4fa2-a887-9633fbba4071' AS house_id, '2025-10-01' AS deactivated_date),
    STRUCT('91aa654b-f87c-48fe-b144-2fa8fd9932df' AS house_id, '2025-10-01' AS deactivated_date),
    STRUCT('60b3c00e-fc59-41d3-b6b2-c8deb8f508d2' AS house_id, '2025-10-01' AS deactivated_date),
    STRUCT('b7953ed1-cdc6-4a3d-b731-dbfb28c5cc30' AS house_id, '2025-10-01' AS deactivated_date),
    STRUCT('0c6a2fb0-979a-4ef0-9e5a-5ef0463e3e21' AS house_id, '2025-12-01' AS deactivated_date)
  ])
),
excluded_complexes AS (
  SELECT id FROM UNNEST([
    '09c50e9a-7685-435d-ac36-4934aa7fd39c', '585e7b5b-737d-4ad9-bf25-76fdb0af015a', 'b59820ce-0548-4ade-994d-f617202ad2c5'
  ]) AS id
),

-- 2. Каркас отчета
calendar AS (
  SELECT report_month FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE('2024-01-01'), DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS report_month
),
report_backbone AS (
  SELECT c.report_month, comp.id AS complex_id, comp.name AS complex_name
  FROM calendar c
  CROSS JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.complexes` comp
  WHERE comp.id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM excluded_complexes)
),

-- 3. Чистые помещения (Используем space_apartments и space_commercials)
clean_spaces AS (
  SELECT 
    s.id AS space_id, h.complex_id, DATE(s.created_at) as created_at, s.owner_id, hd.deactivated_date
  FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.spaces` s
  JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.sections` sec ON s.section_id = sec.id
  JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.houses` h ON sec.house_id = h.id
  LEFT JOIN house_deactivation_dates hd ON h.id = hd.house_id
  WHERE h.complex_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM excluded_complexes)
    AND (
      s.id IN (SELECT id FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.space_apartments`) 
      OR s.id IN (SELECT id FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.space_commercials`)
    )
),

-- 4. Все привязки пользователей (Владельцы + Арендаторы) с флагом "Владелец ли он?"
all_user_mappings AS (
  SELECT owner_id AS user_id, space_id, complex_id, 1 AS is_owner 
  FROM clean_spaces WHERE owner_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT su.user_id, cs.space_id, cs.complex_id, 0 AS is_owner 
  FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.space_user` su JOIN clean_spaces cs ON su.space_id = cs.space_id
),

-- 5. Агрегация базы CRM по месяцам
crm_users_monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    rb.report_month,
    rb.complex_id,
    -- ПУНКТ 2: Всего пользователей в CRM для этого ЖК (Накопительно)
    COUNT(DISTINCT aum.user_id) AS total_crm_users,
    -- ПУНКТ 1: Подтвержденные "настоящие" (без инактивированных)
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
      WHEN u.verified = TRUE AND (u.role IS NULL OR u.role != 'ROLE_INACTIVATED_CITIZEN') 
      THEN aum.user_id 
    END) AS active_confirmed_users,
    -- ПУНКТ 3: Не владельцы (Арендаторы / сожители)
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.verified = TRUE AND aum.is_owner = 0 THEN aum.user_id END) AS tenant_users

  FROM report_backbone rb
  LEFT JOIN all_user_mappings aum ON rb.complex_id = aum.complex_id 
  LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.users` u ON aum.user_id = u.id
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC(DATE(u.created_at), MONTH) <= rb.report_month
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),

-- 6. Продуктовые ивенты
amplitude_events_mapped AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(e.event_time) AS activity_date,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(e.event_time), MONTH) AS activity_month,
    aum.complex_id,
    e.amplitude_id,
    e.event_type,
    CASE WHEN e.event_type IN (
        'request_new_desc_btn_success_ok_tap', 'active_receipt_popup_payment_success_view', 
        'active_receipt_popup_payment_fail_view', 'vote_details_active_form__tap',
        'paid_service_description_btn_success_ok_tap', 'key_open_btn__click', 
        'widget_home_key_btn__click', 'widget_control_center_key_btn__click', 
        'widget_lock_key_btn__click', 'temp_key_create__success'
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_core_event
  FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.EVENTS_407641` e
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.phone AS phone_number, m.complex_id 
    FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.users` u
    JOIN all_user_mappings m ON u.id = m.user_id
    WHERE u.verified = TRUE AND u.phone IS NOT NULL
  ) aum ON JSON_VALUE(e.user_properties, '$.phone_number') = aum.phone_number
  WHERE e.amplitude_id IS NOT NULL AND DATE(e.event_time) >= '2024-01-01'
),

-- 7. Расчет DAU и MAU
daily_active_users AS (
  SELECT 
    activity_month, activity_date, complex_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_core_event = 1 THEN amplitude_id END) AS daily_core_active
  FROM amplitude_events_mapped
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
avg_dau_per_month AS (
  SELECT 
    activity_month, complex_id,
    CAST(ROUND(AVG(daily_core_active)) AS INT64) AS avg_daily_active
  FROM daily_active_users
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
monthly_product_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    activity_month AS report_month,
    complex_id,
    -- ПУНКТ 6: Посетители за месяц
    COUNT(DISTINCT amplitude_id) AS visitors_mau,
    -- ПУНКТ 5: Активные за месяц
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_core_event = 1 THEN amplitude_id END) AS core_active_mau
  FROM amplitude_events_mapped
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)

-- 8. ИТОГОВАЯ СУПЕР-ВИТРИНА
SELECT 
  rb.report_month,
  rb.complex_name,
  rb.complex_id, -- Оставил ID для удобства джойнов в дашбордах
  
  -- CRM Метрики (Люди)
  COALESCE(crm.total_crm_users, 0) AS total_users,
  COALESCE(crm.active_confirmed_users, 0) AS confirmed_users,
  COALESCE(crm.tenant_users, 0) AS non_owners,
  
  -- Amplitude Метрики (Активность)
  COALESCE(pm.visitors_mau, 0) AS visitors_mau,
  COALESCE(pm.core_active_mau, 0) AS active_monthly,
  COALESCE(dau.avg_daily_active, 0) AS active_daily
  
FROM report_backbone rb
LEFT JOIN crm_users_monthly crm ON rb.report_month = crm.report_month AND rb.complex_id = crm.complex_id
LEFT JOIN monthly_product_metrics pm ON rb.report_month = pm.report_month AND rb.complex_id = pm.complex_id
LEFT JOIN avg_dau_per_month dau ON rb.report_month = dau.activity_month AND rb.complex_id = dau.complex_id
WHERE rb.report_month <= DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH)

-- 2. База квартир с расшифровкой адреса дома из таблицы locations
apartments_infrastructure AS (
  SELECT 
    s.id AS space_id,
    h.complex_id,
    comp.name AS complex_name,
    h.id AS house_id,
    -- Делаем понятную расшифровку адреса дома (Улица + Номер)
    CONCAT(loc.street, ', ', loc.number) AS house_address,
    s.owner_id
  FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.spaces` s
  JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.sections` sec ON s.section_id = sec.id
  JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.houses` h ON sec.house_id = h.id
  JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.complexes` comp ON h.complex_id = comp.id

    SELECT id, name FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.complexes` WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM excluded_complexes)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS id, 'Відтік (ЖК не вказано / Архів)' AS name
  ) comp
),
infrastructure AS (
  SELECT 
    rb.report_month,
    rb.complex_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (s.id IN (SELECT id FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.space_apartments`) OR s.id IN (SELECT id FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.space_commercials` WHERE type != 'parking' OR type IS NULL)) THEN h.id END) AS houses_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.id IN (SELECT id FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.space_apartments`) THEN s.id END) AS apartments_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.id IN (SELECT id FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.space_commercials` WHERE type != 'parking' OR type IS NULL) THEN s.id END) AS commercials_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.id IN (SELECT id FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.space_commercials` WHERE type = 'parking') THEN s.id END) AS parkings_count
  FROM report_backbone rb
  JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.houses` h ON rb.complex_id = h.complex_id
  LEFT JOIN house_deactivation_dates hd ON h.id = hd.house_id
  LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.sections` sec ON h.id = sec.house_id
  LEFT JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.spaces` s ON sec.id = s.section_id
  WHERE (hd.deactivated_date IS NULL OR rb.report_month < hd.deactivated_date)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
clean_spaces AS (
  SELECT s.id AS space_id, h.complex_id, s.owner_id
  FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.spaces` s
  JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.sections` sec ON s.section_id = sec.id
  JOIN `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.houses` h ON sec.house_id = h.id
  WHERE h.complex_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM excluded_complexes)
),
all_user_mappings AS (
  SELECT owner_id AS user_id, complex_id, 1 AS is_owner FROM clean_spaces WHERE owner_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT su.user_id, cs.complex_id, 0 AS is_owner FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.space_user` su JOIN clean_spaces cs ON su.space_id = cs.space_id
),
user_base AS (
  SELECT 
    u.id AS user_id, u.phone, u.created_at, u.verified, u.role,
    -- ФОРСИРОВАННАЯ АРХИВАЦИЯ:
    -- Если роль деактивирована ИЛИ человек потерял связь с квартирой (complex_id IS NULL) -> в Архив
    CASE 
      WHEN u.role = 'ROLE_INACTIVATED_CITIZEN' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
      WHEN m.complex_id IS NULL THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
      ELSE m.complex_id
    END AS complex_id
  FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.users` u
  LEFT JOIN (
     SELECT user_id, complex_id, MAX(is_owner) AS is_owner
     FROM all_user_mappings
     GROUP BY 1, 2
  ) m ON u.id = m.user_id
  -- Оставляем ВСЕХ жильцов с квартирами. А "бездомных" берем ТОЛЬКО верифицированных.
  WHERE m.complex_id IS NOT NULL OR u.verified = TRUE
),
user_activity_flags AS (
  SELECT 
    JSON_VALUE(e.user_properties, '$.phone_number') AS phone_number,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(e.event_time), MONTH) AS activity_month,
    1 AS is_visitor,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_type IN (
      'request_new_desc_btn_success_ok_tap', 'active_receipt_popup_payment_success_view', 
      'active_receipt_popup_payment_fail_view', 'vote_details_active_form__tap', 
      'paid_service_description_btn_success_ok_tap', 'key_open_btn__click', 
      'widget_home_key_btn__click', 'widget_control_center_key_btn__click', 
      'widget_lock_key_btn__click', 'temp_key_create__success'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_target_active
  FROM `analytics-454817.postgresqldim9000.EVENTS_407641` e
  WHERE e.amplitude_id IS NOT NULL AND session_id IS NOT NULL AND JSON_VALUE(e.user_properties, '$.phone_number') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
user_history AS (
  SELECT 
    rb.report_month, 
    rb.complex_id, 
    ub.user_id, 
    ub.verified,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN act.activity_month = rb.report_month THEN act.is_visitor END), 0) AS is_visitor_1m,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN act.activity_month = rb.report_month THEN act.is_target_active END), 0) AS is_target_active_1m,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN act.activity_month >= DATE_SUB(rb.report_month, INTERVAL 2 MONTH) THEN act.is_visitor END), 0) AS is_visitor_3m,
    COALESCE(MAX(act.is_visitor), 0) AS is_visitor_12m
  FROM report_backbone rb
  JOIN user_base ub ON rb.complex_id = ub.complex_id
  LEFT JOIN user_activity_flags act 
    ON ub.phone = act.phone_number 
    AND act.activity_month BETWEEN DATE_SUB(rb.report_month, INTERVAL 11 MONTH) AND rb.report_month
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC(DATE(ub.created_at), MONTH) <= rb.report_month
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
)
SELECT 
  rb.report_month,
  rb.complex_name,
  
  COALESCE(MAX(inf.houses_count), 0) AS count_houses,
  COALESCE(MAX(inf.apartments_count), 0) AS count_apartments,
  COALESCE(MAX(inf.commercials_count), 0) AS count_commercials,
  COALESCE(MAX(inf.parkings_count), 0) AS count_parkings,
  
  COUNT(DISTINCT uh.user_id) AS total_users,
  -- Обрати внимание: мы убрали фильтр is_deactivated_now, теперь считаются все верифицированные!
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN uh.verified = TRUE THEN uh.user_id END) AS confirmed_users, 
  
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN uh.verified = TRUE AND uh.is_visitor_3m = 1 THEN uh.user_id END) AS alive_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN uh.verified = TRUE AND uh.is_visitor_3m = 0 AND uh.is_visitor_12m = 1 THEN uh.user_id END) AS sleeping_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN uh.verified = TRUE AND uh.is_visitor_12m = 0 THEN uh.user_id END) AS dead_users,
  
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN uh.verified = TRUE AND uh.is_visitor_1m = 1 THEN uh.user_id END) AS mau_visitors,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN uh.verified = TRUE AND uh.is_target_active_1m = 1 THEN uh.user_id END) AS mau_target_active

FROM report_backbone rb
LEFT JOIN infrastructure inf ON rb.report_month = inf.report_month AND rb.complex_id = inf.complex_id
LEFT JOIN user_history uh ON rb.report_month = uh.report_month AND rb.complex_id = uh.complex_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
